panels.title: Collection gaps in this range

options.content: Every count comes from a Reach Around export that already applied the privacy floor of 5. A row under the floor is never stored alone: small rows are merged into one line named `(below the floor)`. On a day with any small row, the largest row joins that line too, so a link can be missing on such a day. Any count between 1 and 4 shows as **Under 5**. A day marked red had no or partial data collection, and a missing point is not a zero: it is a gap or a count under the floor. Sample data is synthetic.
